data.name: Guthry
data.gender_notes: Guthry is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'God' and 'Thrige' meaning 'throng' or 'people'. This name signifies the wealth or abundance bestowed by God. The name Guthry carries the meaning “God's wealth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Guthry usually hope their child will grow to embody god's wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Guthry belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's wealth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Guthry total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_latin.name: Guthry

Nomen huius generis, in Ecclesia Christiana, a saeculo quarto, usus est ad designandum homines qui virtutes habent et fortitudo habent. Guthry, nomen Christianum, significat hominem qui virtutes habet et fortitudo habet, et qui virtutes habet et fortitudo habet, in Ecclesia Christiana, in omni mundo.
